answer: New identities pay a registration fee that doubles for each further identity from the same funding cluster in one seven-day window — 20, 40, 80, 160 POA — and wait 14 days before gaining any vote, with the fee held in escrow until maturity. Five fakes therefore cost 620 POA in fees plus 14 days each, while a single honest identity pays only 20. Validators check the cluster graph, fee schedule, and maturity timestamp before granting weight. A lone oasis cannot bridge a tide of fakes when each next crossing costs twice the last.
